get.description: Used to build the permission checklist when editing a role.
Used to populate a role dropdown when creating a user.
Ordered by id. A role's domain code (e.g. keuangan, gudang-barang-jadi) decides which FE sidebar dashboard it gets. Used to fill the domain dropdown when editing a role.

put.summary: Edit a role's name and domain
put.description: Superadmin-only for a superadmin role; other roles need role.create. Sets name and domainId (null clears the domain). isSuperadmin cannot be changed here. Users of the role see the new domainCode on their next login or refresh. Fails with 404 for an unknown role and 400 when domainId does not exist.

delete.description: Superadmin only. Fails with 403 for a superadmin role, 404 for an unknown id, and 409 while any user still has the role. Its permission links are removed with it.

409.description: Role still has users or other references

put.summary: Replace all permissions assigned to a role
put.description: Replace-all, not append: the given list becomes the role's complete permission set.

post.summary: Create a user with a given role

put.summary: Update a user's username, email, role, or password

delete.description: Fails with 409 if the user has existing approval or audit history, to preserve referential integrity.
